title: Which PS5 Games Did You Buy During the Pre-GTA 6 Rush?
description: With GTA6 nearly here, publishers scrambled to avoid its impact by packing release schedules from late August to early November. See how PS5 players reacted.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Industry-Shaping Impact of GTA6's Imminent Arrival

In the history of the video game industry, few titles have possessed the sheer gravitational pull of Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece, GTA6. The mere anticipation of this world-beating release has fundamentally altered how publishers plan their release calendars. Fearing the inevitable market dominance of GTA6, companies from all corners of the globe have scrambled to adjust their strategies, opting to cram their titles into a remarkably packed window between the end of August and the beginning of November.

## A Historically Packed Release Schedule

According to recent insights and polling from gaming media outlet Push Square, players have been subjected to one of the most crowded release schedules in recent memory over the past couple of months. This unprecedented traffic jam of games is a direct byproduct of the industry's collective anxiety surrounding GTA6. 

As publishers aggressively pushed their games forward to escape the looming shadow of Rockstar's blockbuster, PS5 owners found themselves spoiled for choice. Shelves and digital storefronts alike overflowed with major releases, forcing gamers to pick and choose which titles to buy during a frantic pre-launch rush.

## Editor's Take
It is fascinating to witness how a single game can dictate the rhythm of the entire global entertainment industry years in advance. The chaotic pre-GTA6 release window proved to be both a blessing and a curse for gamers: an embarrassment of riches, yet an overwhelming test for our wallets and free time.
